Scenario: Orders Based on OTP Validation (API)
Test Data: MSISDN: 254712345678, AgentMSISDN: 254712345678, OrderType: SIM_SWAP, OTP_YN: Y
Test Case Description: Verify OTP expiry time is not extended for new OTP requests
Pre-Condition: Third party system sends API request for SIM_SWAP. Subscriber exists in BSS. OTP expiry time is set to 300 seconds.
Test Steps:

Expected Result: New OTP is generated and sent to subscriber. VALOTP request fails after original expiry time. Error message 'OTP expired' is returned.
